sections.title_en: Dedicatory Epistle to Guidobaldo da Montefeltro, Duke of Urbino
sections.summary: Dedication placing the Libellus alongside De prospectiva pingendi in the Ducal Library of Urbino.

sections.title_en: First Treatise — On Plane Figures and Pentagonal Chords
sections.summary: Exact radical mensuration of triangles, squares, regular pentagons over Q(phi), hexagons, octagons, and inscribed circle chords.

sections.title_la: Tractatus Secundus — De quinque corporibus regularibus in sphaera
sections.title_en: Second Treatise — The Five Regular Bodies Inscribed in a Sphere
sections.summary: Arithmetization of Euclid Book XIII: edges, altitudes, surface areas, circumspheres, and volumes of Tetrahedron, Cube, Octahedron, Icosahedron, and Dodecahedron in a sphere of diameter 12.

sections.title_la: Tractatus Tertius — De mutua inscriptione corporum regularium
sections.title_en: Third Treatise — Mutual Inscriptions of the Five Regular Solids
sections.summary: Pairwise inscriptions among the Platonic solids, highlighted by Casus 4: Piero's original inscription of a Regular Icosahedron of edge sqrt(180) - 6 = 6/phi inside a Cube of edge 12.

sections.title_la: Tractatus Quartus — De corporibus irregularibus et sphaericis
sections.title_en: Fourth Treatise — Irregular, Truncated Archimedean & Vaulted Bodies
sections.summary: Five truncated Archimedean solids, 72-faced mazzocchio sphere, 6-edge general tetrahedron volume formula (anticipating Cayley-Menger), and exact bicylinder cross-vault volume (2/3)d^3.
